newsitem.title: USA: FPA Medical to merge with Health Partners.
newsitem.headline: FPA Medical to merge with Health Partners.

text.p: FPA Medical Management Inc Wednesday unveiled a plan to merge with Connecticut-based Health Partners Inc in a stock swap valued at about $115 million.

In a statement, FPA said the deal, which is expected to close in 1997's third quarter, would be subject to adjustment if FPA's stock fell below $18.00 or rose above $22.00. The merger should add about $160 million to FPA's 1997 proforma revenue, it added.

Health Partners runs a network of 418 physicians providing health services to over 138,000 members. It will expand FPA's reach to Ohio, Kentucky, Washington D.C. and Virginia and will help grow business in New York, New Jersey and Texas.

"We will incorporate FPA's national payor agreements into Health Partners' network of physician providers, which is the largest network of any physician practice management company in the New York region," said Dr. Sol Lizerbram, FPA chairman. "This transaction allows FPA to implement our previously announced strategy of servicing HMO members in the greater New York metropolitan area," he added.
Charles Berg, Health Partners' current chief executive officer, will be named president of FPA's eastern region.
The merger will allow FPA and Health Parters to consolidate services in regional offices in Philadelphia and San Antonio, as well as corporate services.

Oxford Health Plans Inc, a shareholder of Health Partners and its largest payor, has agreed to enter into a 10-year strategic agreement with FPA under which FPA will provide physician services to Oxford's members in existing markets. It also provides a framework for expansion into new markets.

WellPoint Health Networks Inc, also a shareholder of Health Partners, has agreed to enter into a memorandum of understanding with FPA calling for cooperation in mutual markets, focusing initially on California, Arizona and Nevada.
